summary: Controller API KPIs are high latency on /api/controller, high CPU on API pods or nodes, and 503 errors from the gateway when the service is too busy for health checks; the service runs in web pods on OpenShift and on control or hybrid nodes in VM and container installs.
questions: How do I know the automation controller API needs scaling?
Where does the controller API run on OpenShift?
Why does the gateway return 503 for /api/controller?
